summary: Iteration 170 — BidVex Storage Auctions Payment Method + Deposit System. Backend-only API integration testing. 16/16 NEW API tests passing + existing 10/10 pricing/Pydantic unit tests still green (regression intact). Verified all 14 review-request items: public list regression, Stripe Connect Express creation on facility register, 409 duplicate guard with bilingual messages, payment_method='bitcoin' → 422, deposit_required without amount → 422, stripe+no-deposit success, cash+deposit persistence verified via GET, bid endpoint 402 deposit_required with deposit_amount/message_en/message_fr/action='pay_deposit', non-deposit bid succeeds, pricing preview shapes for stripe (buyer_invoice.platform_fee/stripe_recovery/tax/total/remaining_after_deposit + facility_invoice.facility_receives) and cash (facility_invoice.bidvex_platform_fee/facility_owes_bidvex/facility_net), deposit endpoint 422 without payment_method_id and graceful with bogus pm, admin release-deposits 403 for non-admin, admin forfeit-deposit 403 for non-admin and 400 without buyer_id.
